description.content:
Calculates lineage for given metadata object.

**Required Role:** Authenticated User with Active Organization

query.description: Include dbt links in the lineage response
Can be used to specify which direction of lineage to load only. If this field is skipped, source & downstream lineage will be calculated.
Include description in the lineage response
Include tags in the lineage response. This will alter the response slightly to include non-null list of tag guids along with a tags legend.
A list of nodes that need to be filtered out of the response type
Group lineage by data source
Include borderline edges. Borderline edges - edges of which one node is part of this traversal, but the other one isn't
Include the jobs (DAG/Spark) inside the edge objects responsible for the creation of those edges
Include impact score in the lineage response
Include borderline edges linked to tables. Borderline edges - edges of which one node is part of this traversal, but the other one isn't
Include Looker <-> DB lineage
Include looker fields in the lineage calculation
Can be used to specify max depth of lineage to load. `max` is a special value that is used as alias for 20. (1 by default)

Can be used to limit lineage calculation to table or column only. This should reduce payload size as well as computation time but is not fully supported in all Lineage objects (e.g. Looker Lineage doesn't support it fully).
Include Mode lineage

Comma-separated list of root node children GUIDs specifying relevant columns for lineage traversal. When provided, lineage of other root node columns will be ignored. Requires `relevant_lineage` to be enabled.
when `relevant_lineage` is enabled, we only use edges between columns to traverse the graph. Relevant table nodes and edges are still returned in the response, but they are not used for traversal.
Include Tableau lineage
Include the usage type for each edge related to every node in the response. Use `-` to exclude

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Create a new Manual Lineage Edge.
It is needed to specify at least the `guid` for source and target nodes (`source_node` and `target_node`).
The `guid` corresponds to the actual `column` or `table` that is the source or target of the edge.
Also `usage` can be specified. If no `usage` is given, or it is given with `null` value, the edge will be created with `null` usage.


**Required Role:** Admin (or RBAC policy)
